territorial_scope.description: Applies to data processing in the territory of the PRC and reaches processing carried out outside China that harms PRC national security, public interest or the lawful rights of citizens and organisations.

evidence.quote: 在中华人民共和国境外开展数据处理活动，损害中华人民共和国国家安全、公共利益或者公民、组织合法权益的，依法追究法律责任。

agora_harms: Violation of civil or human rights, including privacy

summary.short: Sets rules for data processing and data security in China: data classification, risk monitoring, incident response, a national security review, export controls, and limits on cross-border transfer of important data and on foreign data requests. Penalties apply from 1 September 2021.
summary.long: Governs data processing (collection, storage, use, processing, transmission, provision, disclosure) and data security in mainland China, and reaches processing outside China that harms Chinese national security, public interest or the rights of citizens and organisations. Establishes a central national security coordination mechanism and sectoral and local data regulators. Requires data classification and grading, with catalogues of important data and stricter rules for core data; provides for risk assessment, reporting, incident response and a national security review of data processing. Processors must maintain full-process data security management, training and technical measures; processors of important data must designate a responsible person and submit periodic risk assessment reports. Imposes export controls on certain controlled items, restricts transfer of important data abroad and disclosure of stored data to foreign judicial or law-enforcement bodies, regulates data trading intermediaries, requires administrative licences where other laws require them, and sets rules for government data and open government data. Penalties include warnings, fines (for basic violations 50,000 to 500,000 yuan, higher in serious cases), suspension of business, revocation of licences and civil or criminal liability. Takes effect 1 September 2021.
